# Erectrozil (erectrozil.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Erectrozil, a herbal dietary supplement capsule for adult men (60 capsules per bottle) offered to support energy, stamina and everyday vitality.

## Key facts
- Named ingredients: Hawthorn Berry, Tribulus, Chrysin, Epimedium, Saw Palmetto, Gongk Oil, Winged Treebine, Magnesium (amounts are on the bottle panel)
- Directions: one capsule daily with water, preferably with a meal
- Packs (USD): 1 bottle $89 plus shipping; 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free US shipping); 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping)
- One-time purchase; 60-day money-back guarantee, subject to the terms shown at checkout
- Not a treatment for erectile dysfunction, low testosterone or any condition; adult men only; epimedium is not advised with nitrates; ask a doctor first if taking heart, blood pressure or blood-thinning medicine
